brief:
Israeli police detained Mel Duncan, co-founder of Unarmed Civilian Protection in Palestine (UCPiP), as he returned to Tel Aviv from a tour of the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported. Duncan had been visiting the territory as part of his organization's work.

UCPiP, which deploys unarmed international observers to document and deter violence in Palestinian areas, did not provide further details about the circumstances of Duncan's detention or the charges, if any, he faced.

title: Israeli police detain US activist after West Bank visit
